title: Function Concepts
intro: A function is a rule that assigns exactly one output to each input. This chapter covers function notation, evaluation, domain, range and interpreting functions in context. Read each topic, work the problems with the hint ladder, then take the 8-question topic test.

items.name: Function notation
items.formula: f(x) = … ; f(a) is the output at x = a

items.name: Restrictions
items.formula: no division by 0; no √ of a negative

topics.name: Function Notation
topics.details: Function notation writes a rule as f(x), read “f of x,” where x is the input and f(x) is the output. The letter f is just a name; g(x) and h(x) work the same way. Writing f(3) means “evaluate the function at x = 3.” The notation does not mean f times x — it names an output. A statement like f(2) = 7 says the input 2 produces the output 7. Understanding this lets you read graphs and tables of functions and translate between “the value of the function at 2” and f(2). The SAT relies on fluent reading of this notation throughout the Advanced Math section.

topics.name: Function Evaluation
topics.details: To evaluate a function, substitute the given input value for every x in the rule and simplify. For f(x) = 3x − 4, f(5) = 3(5) − 4 = 11. Mind the order of operations: apply exponents before multiplying, and watch signs when the input is negative — f(−2) with f(x) = x² is (−2)² = 4, not −4. You can evaluate at numbers or at expressions. Careful substitution is the whole task, so use parentheses around the input to avoid sign and exponent mistakes. The SAT tests evaluation constantly, both on its own and as a step in larger problems.

topics.name: Domain
topics.details: The domain of a function is the set of all input (x) values for which the function is defined. For most polynomials the domain is all real numbers, but two situations restrict it. A fraction is undefined where its denominator is zero, so those x-values are excluded — for f(x) = 1/(x − 4), x cannot be 4. A square root needs a non-negative inside, so for f(x) = √(x − 3) you need x − 3 ≥ 0, giving x ≥ 3. To find the domain, look for denominators that could be zero and radicals that could go negative, and exclude or restrict accordingly. The SAT focuses on these two cases.

solved.problem: What x is excluded from f(x) = 1/(x − 5)?
solved.solution: Denominator zero at x = 5, so x = 5 is excluded.

topics.name: Range
topics.details: The range of a function is the set of all output (y) values it can produce. For f(x) = x² + k, the smallest value of x² is 0, so the outputs start at k and go up: the range is y ≥ k. The same reasoning works for f(x) = |x| + k, since |x| ≥ 0. A negative coefficient flips this: f(x) = −x² + k has a maximum of k, so the range is y ≤ k. Finding a range usually means finding the minimum or maximum output and noting which direction the function extends. The SAT tests this mainly for squared and absolute-value functions shifted up or down.

solved.problem: Find the range of f(x) = x² + 4.
solved.solution: x² ≥ 0, so the minimum is 4: range y ≥ 4.

solved.problem: Find the range of f(x) = x² − 3.

Find the range of f(x) = x².

topics.name: Function Interpretation
topics.details: Interpreting a function means explaining what its inputs, outputs and parts mean in a real context. In a model like C(t) = 8t + 50 for the cost of a service after t hours, the input t is hours, the output C(t) is total cost, the slope 8 is the cost per hour, and the constant 50 is a fixed starting fee. A statement like C(3) = 74 means “after 3 hours the cost is $74.” The SAT often asks you to match a number to its meaning, or to read the rate and starting value from a model. Focus on what each variable and constant represents in the situation.

solved.problem: For C(t) = 8t + 50, what does the 8 represent?
solved.solution: The cost per hour (rate of change).
The fixed starting cost when t = 0.

solved.problem: A tank holds W(t) = 5t + 20 liters after t minutes. What does W(4) = 40 mean?
solved.solution: After 4 minutes the tank holds 40 liters.

solved.problem: In P(n) = 12n, what does the 12 mean if n is items sold?

unsolved.answer: After 5 minutes the tank holds 30 liters.
